event_station_013@node_spine_2.quirk: Their wings buzz once, briefly — punctuation, or weather, or both.

event_encounter_trader_001@node_spine_3.quirk: Their form leans toward you slightly, the way a tide considers a shore.

event_station_013@node_spine_4.quirk: There is lichen on their shoulder. Neither of them seems concerned.

shipLog.text: ◆ Docking at the station! ARIA has prepared a warm greeting for the dockmaster! The dockmaster has prepared an invoice! Everyone is ready!
◆ The crop is in! ARIA has declared it the finest crop in recorded history! She has not looked up recorded history!
Arrived at Marginal Eden! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Arrived at Terminal Ambivalence! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Something in Cargo Bay 3: we chose “Secure the crate”. Love that for us!
The crate is secured. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
Arrived at Nebula 3! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
A Commercial Opportunity: we chose “Trade pleasantries and move on”. Love that for us!
You swap route gossip and weather reports — there is no weather, but… +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Still thinking about launch day! Every system was perfect and the paperwork was barely any paperwork at all!
Arrived at Crossroads (The Space Version)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ MARV appends the reading: keeping a drive alive far from any shipyard is half of what spaceflight is.
Engine Fault: we chose “Engineer powers down the coil and rebuilds it”. Love that for us!
The engineer shuts the coil down cold, strips it… DR. OSEI −4 MORALE, KAZUKI −1 MORALE, 6 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ The wheat has reached the height specified in the manual. It did this without ambition. The manual respects that.
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 41% grown, health 100. Thriving!
Arrived at Planet McPlanetface! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The wheat came up exactly on schedule. Nobody aboard can remember the last time anything else did.
Past the Point: we chose “Gather the crew and say it plainly”. Love that for us!
You call everyone to the galley and tell them straight: no turning… +4 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Planetfall approach! ARIA recommends looking out the window instead of at her status report! She'll summarize: planet!
The Wheat hit FLOWERING! 50% grown, health 100. Thriving!
